# Version 4.151.0
> **Skia m151 stable** · Released July 30, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.151.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.151.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.151.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.151.0 stabilizes the Skia m151 engine update with managed color-conversion improvements. The release improves WebAssembly exception handling, continues moving hot color operations into managed code, and refreshes HarfBuzzSharp.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m151** — Aligns the bundled renderer with Chrome m151 and incorporates the related upstream bug fixes. ([#4294](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4294), [#4304](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4304))

## Bug Fixes

- **WebAssembly exception handling updated** — Builds WebAssembly native libraries with current exception-handling support and adds preview-runtime coverage. ([#4284](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4284), [#4310](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4310))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Color conversions moved to managed code** — Common SKColor and SKPMColor conversions avoid unnecessary native interop while preserving the existing API behavior. ([#4320](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4320), [#4321](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4321))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1

Refreshes HarfBuzzSharp and its generated bindings for the 4.151 release line.
